title: `Test (coverage)` is red on every push to `main` because `CODECOV_TOKEN` is unset — the four shards are green, the upload is rejected
body:
Found while working #5421. Filed unassigned.

## What is actually red

Run [32397046084](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/32397046084) on `main` (`32ef595f4`), the first fully-completed CI run after #5403 landed:

| job | conclusion | elapsed (job's own `started_at` → `completed_at`) |
|---|---|---|
| Test (coverage shard 1/4) | success | 17:21:19Z → 17:31:50Z |
| Test (coverage shard 2/4) | success | 17:21:19Z → 17:30:01Z |
| Test (coverage shard 3/4) | success | 17:21:19Z → 17:31:56Z |
| Test (coverage shard 4/4) | success | 17:21:19Z → 17:31:56Z |
| **Test (coverage)** (merge + upload) | **failure** | 17:31:58Z → 17:32:40Z |

All four shards pass. The merge job gets as far as `Merge the shard reports into one coverage report` (success), then fails at `Upload coverage to Codecov`:

```
-> Token length: 0
info -- Found 1 coverage files to report
info -- > /home/runner/work/objectui/objectui/coverage/coverage-final.json
info -- Upload queued for processing complete
error -- Upload queued for processing failed: {"message":"Token required - not valid tokenless upload"}
==> Failed to run upload-coverage
```

`#5403`'s loud verdict step then reports it exactly as designed:

```
SHARDS: success
UPLOAD: failure
##[error]shards=success upload=failure — no report was uploaded for 32ef595f4b6765c61f763a1116a55bbb6f963455,
so the coverage number on the dashboard is STALE, not unchanged
```

## The cause

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` already spells the step correctly — it passes `token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}` and sets `fail_ci_if_error: true`. The uploader reports `Token length: 0`, i.e. the repository secret resolves to the empty string: it is not set (or is set empty). Codecov no longer accepts tokenless uploads for this repository, so the upload is refused server-side.

Nothing about the test suite is involved. The merge step is also where the configured `coverage.thresholds` are enforced over the whole map, and that step passed — so the *gate* half of this lane is working; only the *dashboard* half is broken.

## Why it needs a decision, not just a commit

This cannot be closed by a PR: setting a repository secret is a maintainer action in GitHub settings. And there is a real choice underneath it, because #5403 deliberately chose `fail_ci_if_error: true` so that a silent upload failure could not pass as green:

- **A. Set the `CODECOV_TOKEN` repository secret.** No code change; the workflow already reads it. The lane goes green and the dashboard resumes tracking `main`.
- **B. Retire the Codecov upload.** Keep the merged report as a build artifact plus the existing step summary. The thresholds are enforced in the merge step either way, so the gate survives; what is lost is the trend dashboard and PR coverage comments.
- **C. Make the upload conditional on the secret being present.** ⛔ Not recommended: it converts a declared dependency into an optional one and restores exactly the quiet green that #5403 removed.

Between A and B the question is whether anyone actually reads the Codecov dashboard. If yes, A. If no, B is the honest subtraction and removes a third-party dependency from the merge lane.

## Not to be confused with #5421

#5421 reports a deterministic `Test (coverage shard 3/4)` failure. That measurement was taken on the throwaway instrument branch `claude/issue-5403-proto`, whose own added workflow file broke a documentation gate that hashes into shard 3; it was never a property of `main`. Details in the dev report on #5421. This card is the separate, still-live reason the lane is red.
